description: Change the radar: `preview` a rival before adding it (`url`, `name`?: what would be watched, a suggested tier and why), `add` one (`name`, `url`, `tier`?, `note`?, `pages`?; up to 8), `update` one (`competitor` with `name`, `url`, `tier`, `note`, `pages`, `app_store_id`), `confirm` a proposed one, `remove` one (its history stays), `dismiss` a move from the feed (`change`), `discover` rivals from a few web searches (proposed for your yes), or `scan` their pages now (once an hour). Removing and discovering ask first.

app_store_id.description: its App Store app id, to watch the listing

change.description: for dismiss: the move’s id (from competitor_feed)

company.description: the company id (list_companies); not needed when you have one company, asked for otherwise

pages.description: the page addresses to watch, by kind (e.g. {"pricing": "https://rival.com/pricing"}); for update, replaces them

name: manage_competitor
title: Manage competitors
